notes: «كلهم عن الزهري، بهذا الإسناد» : the three routes meet at Zuhri, written once, so it is the shared tail
«على معنى حديث صالح عن الزهري» names another version's transmitter (Salih): a variant group, never a route
«عبد، بن حميد» has a comma inside the name: one man
«حدثنا ابن أبي عمر» then «ح» : the first branch is short and ends at Sufyan, which the tail carries to Zuhri
